title: Myth: const makes things frozen
why_it_matters: Knowing this stops confusing errors with objects and arrays.
explanation: Myth: const values can never change. Fact: const stops you reassigning the variable, but an object's contents can still change. You can edit properties or push to an array, just not point the name somewhere else.
try_it: Declare a const array, push an item into it, then try reassigning it.
